answer: A newcomer signs its pledge with a quill and locks a 6 POA bond in a vault whose key is split into five shares held by five unrelated strangers, each staking 2 POA the work is real. Each epoch a comet event rotates one key-holder, and the new holder re-runs one job live before taking the share, so recorded work fails. The nth identity from one wallet needs n distinct quorums and posts 6n-squared POA (1st 6, 10th 600, 2,310 across ten); a failed re-run slashes the bond and burns every key-holder stake, so strangers refuse keys to a wallet linked to a failed vault.
